Find where to vote on My Voter Portal: https://bit.ly/4yNOhYF
Bring 1 of 7 accepted photo IDs. Can't reasonably get one? Show a supporting ID and sign a Reasonable Impediment Declaration.
Mail ballot: received by 7 PM Nov 3, or postmarked by 7 PM Nov 3 and received by 5 PM Wed Nov 4.
Track it: https://bit.ly/47NOBMd
Independent voter info, not an official government post.

item.caption:
If your kids are off for Election Day, the libraries are here to help.

Burlington Public Library has a real alpaca from the Harvard Alpaca Ranch outside at 11, and kids can ask the ranchers anything (alpaca storytime starts at 10:30). Somerville's libraries are doing Dino Day with storytime, crafts and a fossil dig, 2 to 4 at the West Branch. And on Wednesday, Cary Library in Lexington has 3rd to 5th graders turning a whole sugar pumpkin into pumpkin waffles (register first).

i send out events to parents like you every wednesay - link in bio

#bostonkids #bostonparents #somervillema #electionday #bostonlibraries

📖 A good story deserves to be heard, and so does your voice!

Happy National Authors’ Day, friends! Today, I’m celebrating the stories I’ve had the pleasure of bringing to the page, from the haunted hollows of the Hudson Valley to faraway kingdoms and magical creatures.

My books include:

📚 Legends and Lore of Sleepy Hollow and the Hudson Valley

📚 Legends and Lore of the Hudson Highlands

The brothers of St. John Lodge No. 43, PHA are showing up and setting the example!

Let’s honor that history through action and show the next generation what civic responsibility looks like.
